why_trail.why: Both blockers are the same shape: a claimed guarantee the code does not keep. B2 - the acceptance test re-encodes in the PARENT, so any child-side serialisation divergence is normalised away before comparison; fix is child-written content bytes compared directly. B1 - content() denies one key instead of admitting a known set, and the paired assertion is a one-directional set difference, so an ADDED varying key passes; fix is an allow-list plus a bidirectional assertion. Everything the panel confirmed sound (rev, no-enumeration guard, LF-pinned writes, imported active_id, lint boundary rule) stays untouched, and no caller for the producer is added - that is with the Admiral.

The acceptance assertion now has both operands written by the children: CHILD writes a second artifact, encode(content(manifest)), with its own encoder in its own environment, and the parent byte-compares those files verbatim. Parent-side parsing is kept for diagnostics only. Two supporting moves: each child now runs with cwd= its own checkout (previously both inherited pytest's cwd, so cwd - the one env fact run_facts reads - was a constant that could hide a leak), and a new TheComparisonHasTeeth class runs the same harness against deliberately poisoned producers plus an unpoisoned control, so the harness is proven able to fail.

content() now admits CONTENT_KEYS=(contract,step,files) instead of denying 'run'. The two spellings agree on today's envelope and diverge on every future one: denial makes a new key content by default, admission excludes it by default. Both set assertions are bidirectional (set(m) == set(content(m)) | {run}), which is what actually kills an ADDED key; a new test welds the envelope to the allow-list so neither can drift alone; and the M36 leak is pinned directly in both its forms. The module docstring now states the admit-not-deny mechanism rather than asserting the guarantee abstractly.

S3: RealCheckoutSkew now materialises the skew instead of hoping for it - it projects a declaration of two tracked, unmodified files (which must AGREE across the two checkouts, the determinism half that never previously executed) plus one file the test creates untracked in the working tree only (which must DIFFER, the skew half), plus one absent from both. Presence lists are asserted literally and a differed counter asserts the headline branch ran, so the class can no longer pass vacuously. S6: the shipped Commander declaration is pinned as a literal (root, path, required) list - the only place a dropped entry or a retargeted root token is visible, since every other check is a self-referential oracle. S7: declaration_of's type guard is exercised through both declaration_of and build_manifest for str, bytes, dict, int and bool, with the absent/empty cases pinned as still-forgiving.

The two process-artifact citations #300 introduced are gone: the DIT-COMPARISON and OBLIGATIONS-301 pointers in CHECKLIST_ENGINE_DESIGN.md are replaced by the facts themselves (durability and cardinality stated inline), and rev()'s docstring no longer cites 'the gate's .gitattributes grep'. The .gitattributes condition is now named as what it is - a configuration invariant - and made checkable from main by test_gitattributes_exempts_no_path_from_lf_normalisation, which is deliberately pattern-blind so a scoped exemption like 'skills/**/references/*.md -text' fails it too; that is the exact shape the critic showed slipping through. Remaining 'agent-work' strings in these files are the production path shape, now spelled <agent_work_root> after the function's own parameter.

Deleted with zero callers: RUN_POINTER (replaced in m2 by CONTENT_KEYS, which the code actually uses), run_facts(session_id=) - so no manifest carries a permanently-null field any more - run_facts(now=), build_manifest(run=), produce(run=). build_manifest(step=) goes too: its one test caller now marks init terminal and lets active_id arrive at context, which is how a real run reaches it, and removing the override means there is no longer any way to build a manifest for a step production never selects. That is a strengthening of 'active_id is THE selector', not just fewer lines. test_a_live_spine_in_this_work_area_also_projects deleted - a 24-line body whose own comment argued it could never run in CI. No caller was added for the producer; that question is with the Admiral.

Full suite 1234 passed / 2 skipped / 337 subtests, exit 0 (was 1226 passed before this rework - net +8 tests, and no test was weakened). Mutation sweep against the shipped state, run in two sandbox worktrees at HEAD, one carrying the rework: M49 env-dependent encoder, M36 varying field outside /run, M19 swallowed declaration type guard, and S8 a -text exemption scoped to exactly the declared corpus - all four SURVIVED at HEAD (exit 0) and are now killed (exit 1). Sandboxes removed and pruned; only the four pre-existing worktrees remain.

IMPLEMENTER_RESULT-rework2.md written from the shipped diff, not from intent: every number in it (52/11/14, 1234 passed, +449/-99 across 4 files, the four mutation before/after pairs) was read off a command run in this session after the last code edit. It records what was deliberately NOT done (no producer caller - that is with the Admiral), the one verification command in REWORK-2 that cannot pass as written and why deviating beat widening, and the assumptions RealCheckoutSkew now rests on.
